profile.headline: Software Engineer at Google
profile.summary:
- PhD in Electrical Engineering
- 5+ work experience in data analytics for healthcare and telecommunication domains 
- 6+ years of research experience in wireless communications

positions.title: Staff Research Engineer II
positions.description: Internal tools to facilitate projects' management and monitoring

positions.title: Staff Research Engineer
positions.description:
- Performed usage analytics for Samsung’s open research study on blood pressure (MyBpLab) using Scala and Apache Spark 
- Designed and developed RESTful APIs in Java Spring Framework with MySQL as persistence layer
- Architected a serverless data collection platform in AWS

positions.title: Senior Research Engineer
positions.description:
- Worked on Samsung’s first Home-Based Cardiac Rehab program as part of the pilot team
- Created Apache Spark jobs in Java and Scala to clean, parse, aggregate and process patient data
- Designed and implemented RESTful APIs in Java Jersey framework to collect patient data using Apache Phoenix as data layer
- Implemented controls and gathered evidence for SOC2 HIPAA audits
- Routinely carried out system admin tasks including HBase data backup, Fluentd logging, Monit monitoring, server hardening, and vulnerability patching, among others

positions.title: Senior Systems Engineer
positions.description:
- Implemented signal processing and machine learning algorithms in Java for noise cancellation filtering of Digital Subscriber Lines (DSL)
- Optimized algorithms to improve runtime and memory consumption
- Developed Hadoop MapReduce jobs to parse waveform data stored in HDFS
- Wrote scripts in JavaScript to process data stored in MongoDB for analysis and reporting purposes

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
- Investigated several aspects of amplify-and-forward relaying for wireless networks
- Worked in an industry collaborative research program sponsored by InterDigital Canada
- Routinely presented research findings at conferences and to industry sponsors
- Performed various simulations in Matlab which included optimization algorithms, Monte Carlo simulations, iterative channel coding/decoding, and modulation/demodulation

positions.title: Co-lecturer
positions.description:
- Course: Wireless Telecommunications (graduate level)
- Prepared and delivered lectures on diversity and capacity of wireless fading channels

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
- Courses: Digital Communications I & II (graduate level)
- Prepared and delivered lectures on convolutional codes and trellis coded modulation techniques

honors.title: List of Honors and Awards
honors.description:
-IEEE Communications Letters Exemplary Reviewer [2014]
-McGill Engineering Doctoral Award [2010-2013]
-McGill Provost’s Graduate Fellowship [2008]
-Ryerson Faculty of Engineering and Architectural Science Dean’s List [2005-2007]
-Ryerson Scotiabank International Scholarship for Excellence in Academic Achievements [2005-2007]
-Ryerson University In-Program Scholarship [2005-2007]
-Ryerson Faculty of Engineering and Applied Science Award for Academic Excellence [2005-2007]
